items.title: Reduction to rational singularities for the integral closure in a purely inseparable extension of degree p

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for a complete regular local ring of dimension two and characteristic p and a purely inseparable extension of its fraction field of degree p, the integral closure admits reduction to rational singularities (statement lines 2348-2354). The proof (proof lines 2356-2439) chooses a subring over which the defining element has nonzero differential, builds a comparison map from the trace of relative top differentials, proves that its cokernel is annihilated by a nonzero element through an explicit computation on the power basis of the extension, transports the comparison along modifications reduced to sequences of point blowups, and concludes by the bound criterion. H3: an original construction with explicit basis computations and a modification reduction, written out in full.
